title_zh: Palo Alto 家庭买房与入学：2027–28 学年注册前，先核对这三件事
title_en: Buying a Home in Palo Alto: Three Checks Before 2027–28 School Registration
summary_zh: PAUSD 已公布下一学年的优先注册时间。把具体地址、家庭搬迁安排和需要向学区确认的问题放在同一份清单里，让买房与入学计划更清楚。
summary_en: PAUSD has posted priority registration dates for the coming school year. Bring the property address, your moving plans, and your questions for the district into one practical checklist.
body_zh:
当买房计划与孩子入学安排放在一起时，值得先做的一件事，是把“正在看的房子”转换成一个可以核对的具体地址，再把搬家时间和学区问题逐项写清楚。

截至 2026 年 11 月 20 日，Palo Alto Unified School District（PAUSD）官网公布：2027–28 学年优先注册的网上登记于 2026 年 12 月 1 日开放，现场预约于 12 月 7 日开始。请在实际办理前再次查看官网，以当时公布的信息为准。
来源：https://www.pausd.org/enrollment/registration

第一件事：用完整地址核对学区
PAUSD 官方页面提醒，Palo Alto 的部分区域不在其边界内，并提供 School Finder 地址查询入口。比较房源时，把街道、门牌和单元信息记录完整，再从学区官网进入查询工具。不要仅凭城市名称、房源介绍中的一行文字，或别人以前的经历作决定。
查询后，把仍不清楚的问题交给学区 Registration Services 确认，例如地址识别是否准确，以及你的孩子对应年级需要进一步了解哪些安排。

第二件事：把住房与入学事项列成两条时间线
一条写房屋交接、搬家和预计实际入住日期；另一条写需要向学区确认的注册步骤、材料和安排。任何尚未确定的日期，明确标成“待确认”，避免把一个口头预计当作已经落实的计划。
这份时间线可以帮助你与经纪人讨论交易安排，也可以帮助你更有条理地向学区提问。具体资格、材料和入学处理结果由学区确认。

第三件事：先准备问题，再安排下一轮看房
你可以把咨询内容整理成四行：
一、正在考虑的完整房屋地址；
二、计划咨询的学年和年级；
三、预计搬迁与入住时间；
四、需要学区确认的具体问题。
向学区提供与咨询相关的信息即可。教育、身份或家庭敏感资料，请通过其指定的安全渠道提交，不需要放进公开网站留言。

把学校信息放回家庭的日常
学校之外，也可以一起讨论接送路线、家人通勤、课后安排和居家办公空间。若条件允许，实地体验你们预计会使用的路线，并记录不同家庭成员最在意的需求。这样，看房清单会更贴近实际生活。

用心服务每一个家，让每一次交易、每一分投入，都创造更大的价值。CiCi 可以协助你梳理房源比较与搬迁计划，并引导你找到官方核实入口；学校归属、注册资格及安排，仍由学区直接确认。

官方资料核对日期：2026 年 11 月 20 日。
PAUSD 新学生注册：https://www.pausd.org/enrollment/registration
PAUSD 学校安排与转学信息：https://www.pausd.org/enrollment/registration/enrollment-process/school-placement-transfers

body_en:
When a home purchase and a child’s enrollment plans overlap, a useful first step is to turn a listing into a precise address you can verify. Then put the moving timeline and questions for the school district on the same working checklist.

As checked on November 20, 2026, Palo Alto Unified School District (PAUSD) lists December 1, 2026, as the opening of online priority registration for the 2027–28 school year, with in-person appointments beginning December 7. Recheck the district’s website before acting, as the information in effect at that time should guide your next steps.
Source: https://www.pausd.org/enrollment/registration

1. Verify the complete property address
PAUSD’s registration page notes that some parts of Palo Alto fall outside its boundaries and provides a School Finder link. Record the street address and unit information accurately, then access the lookup tool through the district’s website. A city name, a line in a property description, or another household’s past experience should be followed by direct verification.
Take unresolved questions to Registration Services, including whether the address has been identified correctly and which grade-specific matters you should clarify.

2. Build separate housing and enrollment timelines
On one line, record possession, the move, and the expected date you will actually live in the home. On the other, record registration steps, documents, and arrangements that still need confirmation from the district. Mark uncertain dates as pending so that an estimate does not quietly become an assumed commitment.
This working timeline can support a discussion with your agent about the transaction and help organize your questions for the district. Eligibility, documentation, and enrollment outcomes should be confirmed directly by the district.

3. Prepare questions before the next round of tours
Keep your inquiry concise:
The full address of the property under consideration.
The school year and grade you are asking about.
Your expected moving and occupancy dates.
The specific questions the district needs to resolve.
Share information relevant to the inquiry. Submit sensitive education, identity, or household documents only through the district’s designated secure channels rather than a public website contact form.

Bring school information back to everyday life
Alongside enrollment questions, discuss pickup routes, household commutes, after-school arrangements, and work-from-home space. When practical, try the routes you expect to use and record the priorities of different household members. Your property checklist will then reflect the way you actually plan to live.

Thoughtful care for every home means giving each decision and investment a clear purpose. CiCi can help organize property comparisons and moving plans and point you toward official verification resources. School assignment, registration eligibility, and arrangements remain matters for the district to confirm.

Official information checked November 20, 2026.
